reviews.name: Claire Hanrahan
reviews.text:
Don’t think just do - the vibe of the trip and I couldn’t agree more!
I had followed SYB on social media for a little while and after a call with their founder Mantas I booked my first SYB trip to Iceland. I wanted to see the real Iceland and not just drive to the typical tourist spots and that’s what exactly this trip allowed.
I was a little hesitant as I was coming from Australia, the furthest I had ever been from home and it was so cold. However once I met the crew I knew this was exactly where I should be.
Whilst I don’t surf, do much yoga or drink beer( love champagne and wine) I loved what this trip stood for which was we exercised hard but also partied hard! Everyone was there for a good time!
I had the most incredible leaders Bradford, Elena, Ken and Chuko who made sure this trip was an unforgettable experience and were always so warm and welcoming. It wouldn’t have been the same without them. The crew was also so much fun and we had a ball.
Not sure I can go back to Iceland now as I don’t think I’d ever be able to top this experience. So book that trip as you won’t regret it.
Claire (Australia)

Turkish Riviera ⛵️🇹🇷

What a week! We were so lucky to have Eli and Nikki as our SYB leaders. They were both amazing and honestly made the trip what it was.

Eli brought the  adventure every day — from hiking and watersports to jumping off the boat, exploring and plenty of laughs along the way. Nikki’s yoga and meditation sessions were the perfect balance and a great way to slow down after a big day.

They were both so easy-going, encouraging and genuinely fun to be around. Nothing ever felt forced and, because we were such a small group, it felt like we all became friends really quickly.

There were so many laughs, a lot of drinks, plenty of adventures and memories I’ll be talking about for a long time. I also loved watching the way they led the group — calm, inclusive, encouraging and always making everyone feel comfortable. Definitely some leadership qualities I’ll be taking home with me!

Couldn’t have asked for better leaders. Thanks for such an incredible week, Eli and Nikki — you guys were the best! ❤️🍾

reviews.name: Ashley Anderson
reviews.text:
This was my fourth Surf Yoga Beer trip, and it was hands down my best one yet. Türkiye and the Turkish Riviera were spectacular, but Nikki R. and Eli Elmore were what made this experience truly exceptional.

This was my second trip with Eli, and he is by far my favorite leader to travel with. He has an innate ability to lead with confidence while remaining thoughtful, approachable and deeply respectful of everyone around him. His conviction in the way he lives, his ability to bring people together and his willingness to extend grace when it is needed set him apart. He creates an environment where people feel supported, included and encouraged to become the best versions of themselves. Eli alone makes any experience ten times better, regardless of the destination, and I would travel anywhere with him as a leader.

Nikki brought an entirely different and equally valuable energy to the trip. She made everything more fun while also having a remarkable ability to make everyone feel comfortable being completely themselves. From creating TikTok music videos and laughing over the smallest things to having meaningful one-on-one conversations, she knew exactly when to bring the energy and when to slow down and genuinely connect.

Nikki was also one of the best yoga instructors I have ever practiced with. Meditation and journaling have always been difficult for me, but her guidance made both feel natural, accessible and meaningful. She leads with kindness, and that kindness speaks volumes. Nothing about her approach felt forced or performative. She created a safe space that allowed people to open up, reflect and participate at their own pace.

Together, Eli and Nikki created the perfect balance of adventure, structure, laughter, reflection and genuine connection. They made every person feel seen and brought out something special in the entire group. I would enthusiastically book another trip led by either of them and would be especially excited to travel with them together again.

This was more than an incredible vacation. It was a life changing experience, and Nikki and Eli were a huge reason why.

reviews.name: Lyndsay Hern
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from Surf Yoga Beer’s first Côte d’Azur, French Riviera trip, and we honestly can’t say enough good things about the experience.

We originally booked this trip to support our longtime friend Erin, one of the trip leaders. Going into it, we really didn’t know what to expect. We knew these types of group travel experiences tend to attract more solo (and often single) travelers, so as a couple we weren’t sure how we’d fit in.

From the moment we arrived, every single one of the people on the trip made us feel welcomed, included, and genuinely loved. By the end of the week, it felt like we had gained an entire new group of friends.

The itinerary was definitely go, go, go! If we had one small piece of feedback, it would be to build in a little more downtime at some beaches to relax and soak it all in. That said, we’re both very active and social people, so we loved how much we were able to experience.

Our welcome dinner the first night in Cassis was incredible—a family-style seafood feast with so many amazing dishes to try.

The kayaking adventure through the Calanques was one of our favorite experiences. We had never been kayaking before, and now we can’t wait to do it again. The scenery was absolutely breathtaking.

In Castellane at Verdon Gorge, we went canyoning for the first time. We’ve floated the American River before, so we thought we knew what to expect…we were very wrong! It was much more adventurous than anticipated, but so much fun. Our guide did an incredible job making everyone feel safe and comfortable throughout the experience. I may have been shivering for the entire hour and a half because the water was freezing (LOL), but it was absolutely worth it.

The lavender field photo shoot was another unforgettable highlight. Even though we had some crazy wind, the fields were stunning, and Matas somehow managed to capture absolutely gorgeous photos despite the conditions.

Our bike tour through Saint-Tropez was another favorite. We only wish we had more time to explore the town because we completely fell in love with it. Between the beautiful beaches, an amazing lunch, and winery visit, it was an incredible day that ended with an amazing group dinner at Crazy Pizza.

The four leaders absolutely made this trip what it was. Erin has been one of my best friends since high school, so I already knew how amazing she is. But watching her lead a large group was incredible. Whether she was leading a killer morning yoga session, planning an unforgettable SHELLONA beach club day (which was one of the highlights of the trip, and for being a “free night” all 27 of us went and it was worth the cost!), or being the first one ready to celebrate and have fun at night, she brought such an authentic, positive energy that made everyone want to have fun.

Christian was pure positivity from start to finish. His energy is genuinely contagious. From 7 a.m. workouts to turning every bus ride into a dance party, he had everyone laughing, singing, and smiling. He has a way of making every single person feel included, and that kind of leadership is something special.

Matas was our incredible photographer, and we are so grateful he was there to capture memories we’ll have forever. Beyond his talent behind the camera, he’s one of the most genuine, down-to-earth people we’ve met. It was awesome getting to know him when he wasn’t busy documenting the adventure.

Holly was equally amazing. She constantly made an effort to connect with everyone, made people feel welcome, and led some fun workouts. Her encouragement and chill vibes never went unnoticed.

If you ever have the opportunity to join a trip with Erin, Holly, Christian, and Matas, consider yourself lucky. They created an environment where complete strangers became friends and where everyone truly felt like they belonged.

This was our first Surf Yoga Beer trip, and it absolutely won’t be our last. We have nothing else to compare it to, but if this is the standard, we can’t wait to book another adventure.

If you’re on the fence, don’t overthink it.

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Nikki Boldes
reviews.text:
Just got back from an unforgettable week in the Turkish Riviera with SYB—my first trip with them, and definitely not my last! From start to finish, it was the perfect mix of relaxation, exercise, and adventure. Days were filled with everything from yoga, hiking, floating, water sports, and beach club day parties to peaceful moments laying under the stars.

What made it even more incredible was the people. Strangers quickly turned into new friends, and by the end, it felt like we had built a little family. Sam and Jill were absolutely amazing leaders—motivating us through workouts, bringing the energy at every party, and creating a space where people felt welcomed, supported, and free to be themselves.

If you’re looking for a trip that blends good vibes, stunning views, and meaningful connections, this is it. I can’t recommend it enough!!

reviews.name: Samantha Carducci
reviews.text:
You know those trips where at the end you're thinking, 'OK that was fun, but I'm ready to get home'? That was NOT this. I left wanting to stay forever!

I joined Surf, Yoga, Beer for their incredible trip to Turkey aboard a Gulet, and it was truly unforgettable! From the moment we set sail along the stunning Turkish Riviera, the experience was perfectly curated to balance adventure, relaxation, and connection.

Mornings started either with yoga ont he deck or a hike on the a different remote island, followed by days filled with swimming in crystal-clear waters, catching rays on deck while we sailed to our next island, and fun workouts that left me feeling strong and energized. The meals were a standout—fresh, delicious, and thoughtfully prepared, adding to the overall sense of care and attention to detail. Everything family style. Everything tasting like a 5-star restaurant.

What made the trip even more special was the group dynamic. The Surf, Yoga, Beer team fostered a welcoming and fun environment, making it easy to connect with an amazing group of like-minded travelers. By the end of the trip, I felt like I had gained a whole new set of friends.

If you’re looking for a trip that combines exploration, wellness, and great company, Surf, Yoga, Beer is absolutely the way to go! I already have my second trip booked and am ready to hit the slopes and meet a whole new group of friends!
